name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Set up for the Concentration Curl with dumbbells. Get into a stable position with your core braced.
Pull the weight toward your body, driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower back to the start with control, letting your arms extend fully without losing tension.
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: Concentration Curl is a intermediate other exercise for the biceps, performed with dumbbells.
